Name: JP's Magic Fertilizers
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#00ff00][u]Magic Fertilizers[/u][/color][/i][/b][/size][/font][/center]
[font=Georgia]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because turning an object that is not worth creating into something more powerful makes it worth trying. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4]This mod adds 9 powerful fertilizers that use 1 “Fairy Dust” as their main ingredient. Together with some other minerals from the Mines (Earth Crystal, Frozen Tear, or Fire Quartz), you get 5 units of these powerful magical fertilizers. [/size]


[i][b][color=#00ffff][size=5][u]Fertilizers and their functions are as follows:[/u][/size][/color][/b][/i]


[size=4][b]Extra Fertilizer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZKVXjL5G/Extra.gif[/img][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]﻿When harvesting a single-harvest crop, a copy is generated in its place that will be ready to harvest the next day. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]You cannot use fertilizer on the copy. [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Giant Fertilizer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/90cNY43s/Giant.gif[/img]﻿[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Instantly transform a group of crops in any state into a giant crop.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]Only for crops that can become giant. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]It can only be used once every 7 days in the same location. [/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[b][size=4]Instant Fertilizer[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FRyBSy6b/Instant.gif[/img]﻿[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]It gives you the yield of a crop that can grow back instantly. It also works on fruit trees. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]It can only be used on the same plant or fruit tree once every 5 days. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Seasonal Fertilizer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/C5w6sZTg/Seasonal.gif[/img]﻿[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Allows a regrowing plant to survive into the next season, if this is not its usual season. [/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]The plant will inevitably die next month. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Timeless Fertilizer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T1THJyMd/Timeless.gif[/img]﻿[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Allows crops to be planted out of season and survive.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]The plant will inevitably die next month. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Super Vegetal Fertilizer[/b][/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Y0tyz4K2/Tree.gif[/img]﻿[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Instantly makes any tree or fruit tree grow.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]It can regenerate a tree from the stump. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][font=Georgia][b]Abyssal Fertilizer[/b][/font][/size]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/HkNR1s5p/Abyssal.gif[/img][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]When applied to tilled soil, it keeps it moist every day.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]It applies the “Paddy Field” status to all crops in the area, so they will take less time to grow. (Like Rice)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Dark Fertilizer[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/qRs5KsFb/Dark.gif[/img][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]The fertilizer is applied to plants that can regrow.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]Plants treated with this fertilizer will produce every day instead of as they originally did.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]There is a 15% chance that the plant will wilt each day. [/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Georgia]

[size=4][b]Mitosis Fertilizer[/b][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/WzsfwDRC/Mitosis.gif[/img][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]This fertilizer is applied only to single-harvest crops.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Georgia]When you harvest this crop, an explosion occurs that creates copies of the crop around it.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]At least one copy is guaranteed, and there is a 33% chance of finding additional copies nearby. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia]Copies appear in their initial phase and cannot be fertilized with Mitosis.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Georgia]
[b][i][color=#00ffff][size=5]That would be all. With use, some may need rebalancing, but that can only be determined over time and through feedback. [/size][/color][/i][/b]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
